_comment: Hand-written, not a live capture — OPENAI_API_KEY is unset in this environment so `npm run record` could not be run. This is a faithful reconstruction of a real OpenAI Responses API turn-2 payload shape (gpt-5-nano, effort low) and must be replaced by a real capture (`npm run record`) once a key is available. usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens is deliberately NON-ZERO and internally consistent (input_tokens INCLUDES it; total_tokens = input_tokens + output_tokens; cached_tokens is a multiple of 128 and the prompt clears the 1024-token cache floor) so that the regression test in src/provider/openai.test.ts is load-bearing: with cached_tokens 0 the assertion inputTokens + cacheReadTokens === input_tokens held whether the cached subtraction was present, missing, doubled or inverted. Keep it non-zero when replacing this file.
